title: Fulfulde, Maasina Language (FFM) – L1 & L2 ... - Ethnologue
text: Maasina Fulfulde is a stable indigenous language of Mali. It belongs to the Niger-Congo language family and is part of the Fulah macrolanguage. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is used as a language of instruction in education.
